title: Dulce base shootout in Lazar's briefing documents

tellings.quote: the the idea that there had been this shootout down below in in a base at Dulce and that 64 special forces guys got killed because they had arms and they were not allowed to have arms and the gray shot them

plain: Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that briefing papers Bob Lazar described seeing at S-4, a secret site he links to Area 51 in Nevada, told of a shootout in an underground base at Dulce, New Mexico. According to that account, 64 special forces soldiers were killed by the grays, gray-skinned beings, because the soldiers had brought weapons they were not allowed to carry. If true, it would mean humans and non-humans had shared a secret base, and that it ended in violence.
